about: Halmos results of every proof of tools/proofs/tier1.txt to tier4.txt, and the sha256 of every file they depend on. Written by python3 gates/gates.py --record-proofs; read by gate G-13. The Halmos version is the one installed when the file was written, as the logs do not print it.
rerun: tools/proofs/run_one.sh <tag> <Contract> <function> <seconds> [loop bound]   # one line of a tier file
tools/proofs/run_queue.sh tools/proofs/tier1.txt 4                          # a whole tier, four at a time
python3 gates/gates.py --record-proofs logs/halmos [more log folders]        # rewrite gates/proof-results.json
